 The Vintage Curly Bob Is Making a Comeback, and It’s Full of Old Hollywood Glamour
 Woman's World Follow Ashley Lynch Wed, October 28, 2026 at 11:01 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Wed, October 28, 2026 at 11:01 PM UTC Deagreez Sleek bobs are stepping aside for softer, curlier shapes drawn from Old Hollywood. Among the bob hair trends drawing attention in 2026, the vintage curly bob is bringing renewed attention to rounded silhouettes, bouncy curls and the kind of retro glamour many of us remember admiring on screen.
 What is a vintage curly bob in the current bob hair trends?
 A vintage curly bob is a short hairstyle built on rounded shaping, soft curls or waves and the kind of volume made famous by classic Hollywood. Where today's sleek styles emphasize straight lines and smooth finishes, this curly bob haircut puts movement, fullness and a softer silhouette front and center.
 The term covers several retro-inspired styles that vary in length, curl pattern and shape, from sculpted curls to loose waves to curled-under ends. Cosmopolitan's coverage of the Betty Boop-inspired bob shows how rounded curls and volume create that unmistakable vintage look.

 Where did vintage haircuts like the curly bob originate?
 Many vintage haircuts tied to the 1920s and 1930s featured short lengths, sculpted waves and carefully arranged curls. Betty Boop's hairstyle still serves as a lasting reference point for rounded curls and that playful silhouette so many readers grew up seeing.
 Classic Hollywood actresses popularized glamorous short hairstyles featuring polished waves and shaped curls, and their influence hasn't faded. Modern interpretations borrow from those historical styles while adding contemporary cuts and more relaxed finishes. Allure's coverage of Zendaya's Betty Boop-inspired finger waves shows how early Hollywood and flapper-era styling still shapes celebrity hair today.
 Why is the vintage curly bob trending in 2026?
 Nostalgic hairstyles have become a bigger part of beauty coverage, with retro curls and voluminous silhouettes offering a welcome alternative to minimalist styling. The interest fits broader bob hair trends that embrace texture and movement over smooth, straight finishes.
 Advertisement Advertisement Pamela Anderson's October 2026 Academy Museum Gala appearance put a spotlight on the Betty Boop-inspired bob, with rounded curls and a fuller silhouette. ELLE's coverage of the Dolce Vita bob highlights another glamorous, volume-focused hairstyle drawing from vintage beauty.
 How is a curly bob haircut different from other bob styles?
 A blunt bob typically features a defined, even perimeter, while a vintage curly bob emphasizes rounded styling and visible curls. French bobs are often shorter and may include bangs or more relaxed texture, which gives them a different feel from more sculpted retro styles.
 ELLE describes the Dolce Vita bob as a longer cut with soft, flowing layers, and that longer length helps distinguish it from shorter, sculpted vintage looks. Some bob hairstyles can take on a vintage character through styling alone, meaning the haircut underneath doesn't always need to change.
